name: What is the typical timeline for a major home renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a major home renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a major home renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope, size, and complexity. A full kitchen remodel might take 6-10 weeks, while a bathroom remodel could be 3-6 weeks. Larger projects, like adding a room or a whole-home renovation, could range from 3-6 months or even longer. Factors like permit approval, material lead times, and unforeseen issues can also impact the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Major home renovation timelines vary; a kitchen remodel is 6-10 weeks, a bathroom 3-6 weeks. Larger projects can take 3-6 months or more.
